core_obligations: The author translation encodes attainable arithmetic-gate values and replaces partition-symmetric gates by rigid strictly symmetric threshold gadgets, while proving that group symmetries extend and no extra automorphisms enlarge the gate orbits. Only symmetry and maximum orbit size are preserved; circuit size may grow exponentially, as in the original statement.

dedup.scope: No source/title/claim hit in original/public/worklist metadata. Own two source primaries are transpose-symmetric determinant construction and square-symmetric permanent lower bounds. This theorem translates an arbitrary G-symmetric arithmetic circuit over an arbitrary field and finite target-output set to a threshold circuit, preserving maximum orbit size; the family-specific upper/lower bounds need additional independent constructions.
